## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Dataset or benchmark
- [ ] Refactor or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated

## Industrial safety and data review

- [ ] No credentials, customer data or confidential plant information are included
- [ ] The change does not introduce unsafe write-control behaviour
- [ ] Assumptions, limitations and data provenance are documented
- [ ] Generated or synthetic data is clearly identified

## Notes for reviewers

List important design decisions, numerical tolerances, known limitations or follow-up work.
